subject: Watermelon In Easter Hay drum tab, Songsterr s6857183 r8970744

root_cause.claim: The tab carries one tempo automation at 56.000 bpm for a live take that averages about 55.30 bpm.

the_test.detector: 1024-pt Hann, 256 hop, 44.1 kHz, positive spectral flux in band, 97th pct peaks, 120 ms refractory, 50 ms match tolerance

still_wrong_in_the_shipped_gp.superseded: An earlier pass this session, on the weaker onset-derived clock, read this as bars 98 to 103 and 56 attacks, and called bar 104 correctly empty. Bar 104 carries 5 kick and 4 tom onsets. Only bar 105 is correctly empty.

still_wrong_in_the_shipped_gp.shape: snare or tom, plus tom hi mid, plus ride, on one instant
still_wrong_in_the_shipped_gp.note: Two hands cannot strike three surfaces at once. Fifteen of sixteen pair a ride with a snare and a tom.
One automation at 56.000 bpm across a live performance that drifts.

the_fix.method: per-bar offset search on kick plus snare onsets, monotone by construction, 5 ms steps, 50 ms match tolerance, guitar stem as wrong-stem control

metronome_stem.answer: No new ones. Moises already exported one, and it beats every other clock tested.

three_clocks_head_to_head.metric: kick plus snare onset match rate, 785 tab events, 50 ms tolerance, identical detector
three_clocks_head_to_head.why_onset_map_is_blind: It aligns using tab events. Bars 101 to 105 carry two tab kick or snare events between them, so it had nothing to align with in the exact region under investigation. The metronome carries 74 clicks after t=505 s and needs no tab notes at all.
